author: claude-fable-5-1
visual_review_findings: Compared the original (spiky-haired boy with a forehead headband, closed happy eyes and a smile) with the rejected drawing (a box head with a shallow zigzag top and a band, reading as a bucket or crown) at 48px in both themes. Redrew with three tall uneven spikes on a headband line over a round jaw, dot eyes and an r6 smile. Native review: reads as a spiky-haired smiling character; uneven spikes keep it from reading as a crown.
omissions: headband emblem, ears; closed-eye arches become dots
construction_reference: no direct Lucide match; spikes as lattice triangles with inscribed radius above 3.2
